title: Multitask Hamiltonian Learning across Levels of Theory
exact_target: Develop Hamiltonian learning that shares information across electronic-structure approximations and determine when that sharing improves prediction and sample efficiency.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006232 (OWR-14299094-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mathematical Methods in Quantum Chemistry (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/15, pp. 615--688. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The source gives a learning-framework question, not a universal theorem that sharing always improves every task.
